name: Midnight Courier 2
logline: A courier on a red scooter has 30 seconds to deliver a bag of cash before the clock strikes twelve, with a black SUV on his tail. Sixteen shots.

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Alley, locked wide: the courier waits, the clock reads 11:59

shots.subject: Face
shots.name: Close on the rider's face, tense, eyes forward

shots.subject: Package
shots.name: The cash luggage, rear quarter; focus racks to the gloves

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: In front and above: burnout, smoke beside the bike, the SUV's headlights behind it

shots.subject: Face
shots.name: Close up on the rider as he looks behind

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Crane high over the avenue, slow push-in

shots.subject: SUV
shots.name: Low in front of the SUV: it bears down on the bike

shots.subject: SUV
shots.name: Side of the SUV, a little ahead: we see it plough through the fruit stall

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Bike 1: behind and low, it hits the rising leaf

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Bike 2: from the side over the water, we see the climb and the whole jump (slow motion from 15.43)

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Bike 2b: very close up in the air (same side as the wide shot)

shots.subject: Face
shots.name: His face, close up from the front, in the air

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Bike 3: on the ground ahead of the landing, it comes down toward us

shots.subject: SUV
shots.name: From above: the SUV has skidded to a stop short of the raised leaves; it cannot follow

shots.subject: Front wheel
shots.name: Front wheel and handlebar, speed in the tunnel

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Wide-angle first person through the lit tunnel

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Aerial spiral: out of the tunnel (24.34 s), up the ramp

shots.subject: Face
shots.name: Face close from the front: relief as he slows

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Helipad, close: he drifts and stops as the clock strikes 12

shots.subject: Bike
shots.name: Same view, now pulling far out and wide
